theme: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos
queries_run: gh search repos "tripadvisor dataset reviews" --sort stars
gh search repos "tripadvisor hotel reviews" --sort stars
gh search repos "tripadvisor rental OR vacation rental review" --sort stars
gh search repos "tripadvisor reviews dataset" --sort updated

candidates.name: omkarcloud/tripadvisor-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: MIT-licensed, actively maintained (updated 2026-09-13) Python scraper extracting TripAdvisor hotel and restaurant names, ratings, review text/counts, and contact info at scale; no committed dataset, but a one-command pull tool.
candidates.why_useful: Could be used to build a hotel-review-velocity / rating-trend panel for the hotel comp set (MAR/HLT/hospitality demand read-through) as a non-Airbnb travel-demand proxy; catalogued as method only, not run.

candidates.name: jios325/tripadvisor-reviews-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: MIT scraper using TripAdvisor's GraphQL API plus curl_cffi TLS fingerprinting (no browser automation) to pull hotel reviews; updated 2026-07-04.
candidates.why_useful: Lighter-weight technical route to hotel review counts/dates (review velocity as a demand proxy) than Selenium-based scrapers; still a method, not a dataset.

candidates.name: PRO100CHOK/tripadvisor-hotels-reviews-scraper-python
candidates.what_it_holds: Python scraper for TripAdvisor hotels, restaurants, attractions and reviews, framed explicitly for 'hospitality compset & review sentiment' use cases; updated 2026-06-06, MIT.
candidates.why_useful: Purpose-built for exactly the hotel-compset review-velocity/sentiment use case relevant to a lodging-demand proxy; still unrun/uncommitted data.

candidates.name: wwk990630/tripadvisor-hotel-review-data-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Python scraper for TripAdvisor hotel review data extraction (bilingual EN/ZH readme); updated 2026-08-16, MIT.
candidates.why_useful: Another maintained option for pulling hotel review timestamps/ratings if the team ever wants a hand-built review-velocity index; method only.

candidates.name: andorfermichael/tripadvisor-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Scraper designed to pull hotel reviews for an entire city at once from TripAdvisor (36 stars); no committed data files seen in search result.
candidates.why_useful: City-level batch design is closer to what a review-velocity panel would need (one city -> many hotels -> many reviews) than single-hotel scrapers.

candidates.name: diegma/trip-maml (Trip-MAML)
candidates.what_it_holds: Trip-MAML: a Multi-Aspect Multi-Lingual academic dataset of TripAdvisor hotel reviews in English, Italian and Spanish, annotated at the sentence level for aspect-oriented opinion mining (not the generic single-language Kaggle 20k file).
candidates.why_useful: A genuine multilingual academic replication package rather than a reskin of the well-known Kaggle set; could support cross-region hotel sentiment/aspect comparisons (EMEA/LatAm language coverage) distinct from anything currently held.
candidates.size_hint: sentence-level annotated corpus, 3 languages (exact row count not confirmed without cloning)

candidates.name: robhawkins/happiness
candidates.what_it_holds: Sentiment-analysis project reportedly built on ~70,000 TripAdvisor hotel reviews (fastai/LSTM/stacking/xgboost) -- larger than the standard 20k Kaggle file if the underlying data is genuinely committed; not independently verified beyond the repo description.
candidates.why_useful: If the 70k-review corpus is real and multi-hotel/multi-city, it is a larger free hotel-review base than the common Kaggle set for sentiment/velocity work; flagged for follow-up verification rather than confirmed.

candidates.name: Aspect-Based-Sentiment-Analysis-of-Marrakesh-hotel-reviews
candidates.what_it_holds: TripAdvisor hotel reviews scoped to Marrakesh, Morocco, with aspect-based sentiment code and (per description) the underlying review data for that single city.
candidates.why_useful: Fills a specific North-Africa/MENA geography not otherwise represented in the team's held hotel-review data, useful only as a single-city curiosity for regional sentiment texture, not a KPI driver.

candidates.name: anupamme/scrapeHotelReviewData-1.0
candidates.what_it_holds: A TripAdvisor hotel-review scraping routine (6 stars, 'Other' license); older but still present.
candidates.why_useful: Another candidate scraper if the team ever wants to independently build a hotel review-velocity time series; unrun, uncommitted data.

candidates.name: johnisanerd/Apify-Tripadvisor-API
candidates.what_it_holds: Python + MCP quick-start wrapper for the paid Apify TripAdvisor scraping actor, returning structured JSON for hotels/reviews; updated 2026-09-13 (very recent).
candidates.why_useful: Machine-pullable client for TripAdvisor data via a third-party actor; requires a paid Apify key so lower priority, but confirms an actively maintained pull path exists.
candidates.size_hint: tool only, needs paid Apify API key

candidates.name: zunda-pixel/tripadvisor-swift
candidates.what_it_holds: Swift library wrapping the official TripAdvisor Content API (requires an official API key); updated 2026-09-12.
candidates.why_useful: Confirms the official TripAdvisor Content API is still actively wrapped/maintained by third parties as a legitimate (non-scraping) data-acquisition path, though it needs an API key the team does not have.
candidates.size_hint: tool only, needs official API key

notes: This theme is thin: TripAdvisor's own bulk-download datasets do not appear to exist on GitHub as committed data -- almost every hit is either (a) a scraper/method repo (dozens of near-duplicate 'tripadvisor-scraper' forks/clones, most under ~10 stars, no committed data, README-only), or (b) a student NLP project re-analysing the single well-known Kaggle 'tripadvisor_hotel_reviews' 20k-review CSV (excluded per instructions as a single-file rehash, same pattern as the NYC-2019 Airbnb exclusion) -- I did not list the dozen+ near-identical sentiment-analysis notebooks built on that one Kaggle file. Nothing found that is TripAdvisor-branded VACATION RENTAL (non-hotel) data specifically -- TripAdvisor Rentals/FlipKey has essentially no GitHub footprint; searches for 'tripadvisor rental' returned zero results. No repo found that gives realized ADR/occupancy, booking lead time, or point-in-time TripAdvisor data (gaps #2, #3, #4 remain unfilled by this theme). The most differentiated find is trip-maml (genuine multilingual academic dataset, not a Kaggle reskin). Best path forward for this theme, if pursued further, would be WebSearch for 'TripAdvisor Zenodo dataset' or 'TripAdvisor Kaggle hotel reviews multi-city' rather than more gh search repos calls, since GitHub itself is saturated with scraper forks and thin on committed multi-city/multi-year review corpora. Used all 6 allotted gh search repos calls; no rate-limit errors encountered; did not need gh search code or WebFetch.
